dedupe_keys.name: summary of cargo throughput in major ports

description: Summary of Cargo Throughput in Major Ports is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Summary Of Cargo Throughput For Major Ports for 2005-2019. Data from Mawani Saudi Ports Authority. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Notes: ( Includes: Sugar, Iron Ore, Coal, Cement, Urea, Suplate). ( Includes: Vegetable Oils, Animal Oils, Refined Oil Products, Liquid Petrochemical Products, Liquefied Natural Gas). Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transport, Economy. Its keywords are Cargo. The portal shows 2022-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Private. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
